title: Wilds of Eldraine Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Shaggyfoot
entities.description: A draft animal called out by name by an ox drover.

entities.name: Lumpton
entities.description: A draft animal urged on by an ox drover heading for Edgewall.

entities.name: Edgewall
entities.description: A destination the ox drover aims to reach by sundown.

entities.name: High Fae
entities.description: Fae capable of magics that would make even Gadwick seem a clumsy apprentice.

entities.name: Gadwick, the Wizened
entities.description: A great wizard who comments on the hardness of choosing between two wonders.

entities.name: Chulane, Teller of Tales
entities.description: A teller of tales who speaks of the High Fae's magic.

entities.name: Capashen
entities.description: A family whose members vow to protect the less fortunate and fight on through despair.

entities.name: Brimaz
entities.description: The king of Oreskos, who calls for the pure light of day to overcome the gods' deception.

entities.name: Oreskos
entities.description: The realm ruled by Brimaz.

entities.name: The Cosmogony
entities.description: An in-world writing describing how the gods made the first griffins.

entities.name: Oracle en-Vec
entities.description: An oracle who prophesies a vast shout and then a vaster silence.

entities.name: Ivold
entities.description: A man who looks through lenses hoping to see geists.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who heard Wrenn's call.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A planeswalker whose call reached Teferi.

entities.name: Zhalfirins
entities.description: People of Zhalfir, some of whom were roused from sleep by a strange, otherworldly song.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: A school where temporal manipulation was banned.

entities.name: Minosz
entities.description: The Orzhov chief of security, confident no one could get into a fortieth-floor room.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A guild that employs Minosz as chief of security.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: A speaker who warns that the bonders know everything.

entities.name: Mirrorlake
entities.description: A lake toward which masks float downstream, where faces arise to wear them.

entities.name: Malacan
entities.description: An exile from Vantress who speaks on virtue.

entities.name: Vantress
entities.description: The place from which Malacan was exiled.

entities.name: Imbraham
entities.description: The Quandrix dean.

entities.name: Quandrix
entities.description: A college whose dean is Imbraham.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: A power said to be as impossible to control as diverting a river by hand.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: A god whose acolytes celebrate the arrival of spring's first flowers.

entities.name: Setessan woods
entities.description: Woods filled with song by Karametra's acolytes in spring.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: The elusive queen of the fae, who commands armies and dwells in Glen Elendra.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: A place protected by glamers and guile that harbors Oona.

entities.name: Magic Mirror
entities.description: A mirror that crystallized a mere drop of water into much more.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A secret guild whose insignia is seen only by its members and the doomed.

entities.name: Mairsil, the Pretender
entities.description: A speaker who asks what others have that he cannot obtain.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A master artificer who muses on mana as possibility.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A continent beneath a blanket of dense vegetation.

entities.name: Ardenvale
entities.description: A realm whose loyalty keeps the realm from devouring itself.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A land where peace and harmony are rare, whose tides hide treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

entities.name: Phyrexian war
entities.description: A war whose forgotten treacheries lie beneath Otarian tides.

entities.name: Pulan
entities.description: A Bant orchardist whose trees were transformed one morning.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: The home of the orchardist Pulan.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane whose light has a stronghold.

entities.name: Tazeem
entities.description: A continent where rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who comments on worship when gods become apathetic.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: A city-tree whose seeds grow into children serving the Conclave.

entities.name: Conclave
entities.description: The organization served by Vitu-Ghazi's children.

events.summary: Ivold, looking through his lenses, gasps in surprise, thinking he may be seeing geists at last.
Before Teferi heard Wrenn's call, some Zhalfirins were roused from sleep by a strange, otherworldly song.
events.quote: Even before Teferi heard Wrenn's call, a few Zhalfirins were roused from sleep by a strange, otherworldly song.

relations.quote: Even before Teferi heard Wrenn's call
Glen Elendra harbors the elusive Oona, queen of the fae.

relations.note: Her children rise in service to the Conclave
relations.quote: her children rise in service to the Conclave.

relations.note: Praises the High Fae's magic as surpassing Gadwick's
relations.quote: The High Fae are capable of magics that would make even the great Gadwick himself seem little more than a clumsy apprentice.

relations.note: Otarian tides hide treacheries of the war
relations.quote: Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.

rejected.summary: Temporal manipulation was banned at Tolaria West.
rejected.quote: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.
